summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and a private _resolve_path_value helper (os and json only, no type hints). Exported it in monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection after the Utilities entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Nothing was run: no tests, no repository code, no Black check, since you asked me not to. A grep found no lines over 120 columns. Choices I made: malformed JSON raises ValueError wrapping the decode error; a non-list key value raises ValueError; "test" entries are wrapped as {"image": entry} before validation. Nothing was committed.
